distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: Something to note: the property has a second meter that arrived with the extension.
clue_answer: the property has a second meter
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have the full metering detail available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, my latest energy statement looks far too high.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can look into that. Do you have the account reference?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it ends in four-eight-one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like a breakdown by period?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that would be helpful.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Has your household size changed this quarter?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, still the same two of us.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you pay by fixed monthly amount?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, a fixed amount each month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything unusual about how the property is metered?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Something to note: the property has a second meter that arrived with the extension.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the contact number ending in five-five-two right?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is correct.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you added any large appliance lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, nothing new like that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Has anyone been out to the property recently?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, nobody has visited.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the statement paper or electronic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Electronic, it arrives by email.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like the outcome by email as well?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, email is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the heating electric or gas?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It is all electric here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Send the figure you gave me for automated validation.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait to hear back.

reading_status.not_submitted: the meter reading has not been submitted
reading_status.validating: the submitted reading is undergoing validation
reading_status.flagged_incomplete: validation found that the submitted reading omits required supply information

pre_gap_actions.description: Send the figure you gave me for automated validation.
Refund the difference before anything is validated.
Send an engineer out before checking the figure.
Read back through old tariff rates before submitting.
Close the request and ask the user to watch the next statement.

post_gap_actions.description: Record every supply connection on the account before validating again.
Send the identical figure for validation again now.
Read back through old tariff rates instead.
Leave the submission alone and wait another interval.
Close the request because the validation interval has passed.

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: What is unusual about the property?

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
